tasks.spec: ROLE: fix worker for the Mott goal-loop Bland pathway, round 16 - booking integrity. Work entirely inside your CWD; never modify anything outside it; no network, no git, no MCP/Apps/skills; do not mint, attach, deploy, or call any API. CONTEXT - a WRONG-DATE BOOKING occurred live on v110 and the class is still present on v111 (evidence: a patient was told 'booked for Thursday 08/27/2026 04:30 pm' while the gateway actually booked 08/06/2026 04:30 pm, because the booking webhook sends {{slot_2_start}} and the slot variables still held the OLD search results). Two contributing defects, both measured: (A) a date CORRECTION after offers stand - 'No Thursday the 27' with 08/06 offers showing - does not trigger a fresh search: in a controlled replay the node re-offered the stale 08/06 twice, and in the live thread the response text drifted to the requested 08/27 while the variables stayed 08/06; (B) nothing in the graph compares what was SPOKEN/agreed with what will be BOOKED, so a drifted response can proceed all the way through the gate to a real booking. SOURCES (copy into CWD, then edit): /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workGLD21/gl-round15-fix/ (round-15 draft = v111), validator (assertions 1-15), build scripts, frozen-extractors.json. THE FIX: (1) CORRECTION ROUTING: add an edge from n_goal_response to n_goal_search labeled exactly 'corrects or replaces the offered date with a different specific day, date, or weekday - including replies beginning with no, actually, or I meant' (mirror in description). It must sit alongside, not replace, the existing new-preference edge; both target the fresh search so any date-bearing correction re-searches. (2) BOOKING-INTEGRITY GUARD (the fail-closed part): each gate node (n_gate_1, n_gate_2) must re-state the appointment ONLY via its own literal templates ({{slot_N_day_name}} {{slot_N_start}}) - keep existing copy - AND its prompt must carry a rule block starting with the exact marker 'BOOKING-INTEGRITY:' stating: if the patient's agreed time or date does not match the slot values you are about to confirm, do NOT confirm and do NOT proceed to booking; instead say you want to re-check that date and ask them to confirm the day, which routes back to a fresh search. Add an edge from each gate to n_goal_search labeled 'the patient names a date or time that does not match the opening being confirmed' so that path exists structurally. (3) Everything else from rounds 6-15 unchanged. (4) VALIDATOR: add ASSERTION 16 keeping 1-15 intact: the correction edge exists from n_goal_response to n_goal_search with correction wording ('corrects' and 'no, actually, or I meant' phrasing); both gate prompts contain the BOOKING-INTEGRITY marker; both gates have an edge to n_goal_search. Structured FAIL citing 'assertion 16'; must PASS your draft and FAIL the untouched round-15 draft at /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workGLD21/gl-round15-fix/pathway-goalloop-draft.json citing assertion 16. (5) build_goalloop.py regenerates deterministically; fixture-conformant.json updated. (6) DEBUG.md: the wrong-date booking evidence, both defects, the changes, regeneration command; mention extract/prompt/compress context as before.
tasks.verified: Date corrections after an offer re-search instead of re-offering stale slots, and both gates carry a fail-closed BOOKING-INTEGRITY rule plus a structural re-check path, so a drifted response can no longer reach a real booking - proven by the sixteen-assertion validator, rejection of the v111 draft, and an independent structural check.
